title: Architecture in the United States
displaytitle: Architecture in the United States

titles.display: Architecture in the United States

extract: The architecture of the United States demonstrates a broad variety of architectural styles and built forms over the country's history of over two centuries of independence and former Spanish, French, Dutch and British rule.
